courses.title: Introduction to Programming
syllabus_modules: Computational thinking, Python basics, data types, strings, tuples, lists, dictionaries
Control flow, functions, recursion, aliasing, mutability
Exception handling, concurrency and parallelism, synchronisation
OOP: classes, objects, constructors, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstract classes
Searching and sorting algorithms, asymptotic complexity
references: M. Lutz, Learning Python, O'Reilly, 2013
J. V. Guttag, Introduction to Computation and Programming Using Python, MIT Press, 2016
D. Phillips, Python 3 Object-Oriented Programming, Packt, 2018

courses.title: Introduction to Electronics
syllabus_modules: History of electronics, modern applications
Circuit elements: resistors, inductors, capacitors, independent/dependent sources
DC circuits: Kirchhoff's laws, mesh/nodal analysis
Network theorems: Thevenin, Norton, Superposition, Maximum power transfer, Millman's
Steady state AC analysis, impedance, phasors, power factor
Diodes: characteristics, rectifiers, wave shaping, voltage regulators
BJT: operating regions, current mirrors, switch and amplifier circuits
Op-amp: inverting/non-inverting amplifiers, voltage follower, integrator, differentiator
references: Paul Horowitz & Winfield Hill, The Art of Electronics, 3rd Edn., Cambridge, 2015
S. Sedra & K. C. Smith, Microelectronic Circuits, 7th Edn., Oxford, 2017
Anant Agarwal & Jeffrey H. Lang, Foundations of Analog and Digital Electronic Circuits, Elsevier, 2005

courses.title: Digital Circuits and Systems
syllabus_modules: Number systems, Boolean algebra, logic gates, Karnaugh map, Quine-McCluskey method
Combinational circuits: adders, subtractors, comparators, encoders, decoders, multiplexers
Sequential circuits: latches, flip-flops (RS, JK, D, T, Master-Slave), counters, shift registers
Design of combinational circuits, hazard-free realisation
Synchronous sequential circuit design: Mealy and Moore FSMs, state assignment, state reduction
references: M. Morris & M. Cietti, Digital Design with Verilog HDL, 5th Edn., Pearson, 2013
Roth Jr. et al., Fundamentals of Logic Design, 6th Edn., Cengage, 2020
Brown & Vranesic, Fundamentals of Digital Logic with Verilog Design, 3rd Edn., McGraw-Hill, 2014

courses.title: Practical Electronics
syllabus_modules: Basic electronic components: resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transistors, ICs, LEDs, relay
Diode circuits: half-wave/full-wave rectifiers, clippers, clampers
Transistor as amplifier: biasing, gain, frequency response, power, impedance matching
Battery characteristics, charging/discharging, protection circuits
555 IC: internal structure, astable and monostable operation
references: Paul Horowitz & Winfield Hill, The Art of Electronics, 3rd Edn., Cambridge, 2015
Data sheets of various electronic components

courses.title: Electric Circuits and Networks
syllabus_modules: Transients: initial conditions, natural/forced response, RC and RL circuit analysis, RLC circuits
s-Domain analysis: Laplace transform, nodal/mesh analysis, network functions, poles and zeros
Frequency response, Bode plots, filter characteristics, Q factor, resonance
Two-port networks: Z, Y, H, ABCD parameters, series/parallel/cascade interconnections
Symmetrical two-port networks, image impedance, characteristic impedance
references: K. S. Suresh Kumar, Electric Circuits and Networks, Pearson, 2015
M. E. Van Valkenburg, Network Analysis, 3rd Edn., Pearson, 2015
W. H. Hayt et al., Engineering Circuit Analysis, 9th Edn., McGraw Hill, 2020

courses.title: Semiconductor Devices
syllabus_modules: Quantum mechanics, Schrodinger equation, crystal structure, energy bands, E-K diagram
Semiconductors: carrier concentration, drift, diffusion, Hall effect, continuity equation
P-N junction: equilibrium, IV characteristics, junction capacitance, breakdown, Schottky diodes
MOS system: accumulation, depletion, inversion, threshold voltage, C-V characteristics
MOSFET: structure, DC characteristics, channel length modulation, short channel effects, small signal model
Simulation using SPICE/MATLAB/TCAD; hardware experiments on diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs
references: D. A. Neamen, Semiconductor Physics and Devices, 4th Edn., McGraw Hill, 2021
S. M. Sze, Physics of Semiconductor Devices, 3rd Edn., Wiley, 2008
C. C. Hu, Modern Semiconductor Devices for Integrated Circuits, Pearson, 2010

courses.title: Digital Systems Lab
syllabus_modules: Introduction to Verilog: modules, ports, wires, registers, behavioural and gate-level modelling
Logic synthesis, RTL synthesis, Xilinx FPGA architectures
Implementation: combinational circuits, arithmetic circuits, flip-flops, counters, sequence detectors
references: Roth Jr. et al., Fundamentals of Logic Design, 6th Edn., Cengage, 2020
S. Palnitkar, Verilog HDL, 2nd Edn., Prentice Hall, 2003

courses.title: Signals and Systems
syllabus_modules: Continuous-time LTI systems, Laplace transform, impulse response, convolution, transfer function
Poles and zeros, stability, Fourier transform, frequency response, bandwidth, Fourier series
Sampling theorems (lowpass and bandpass), discrete-time sequences and systems
Linear difference equations, z-transform, stability of discrete-time systems
Discrete Fourier series, DTFT, DFT, properties of DFT matrix
references: B. P. Lathi, Linear Systems and Signals, Oxford University Press, 2004
Oppenheim, Willsky & Nawab, Signals and Systems, 2nd Edn., PHI/Pearson, 2011
M. Vetterli et al., Foundations of Signal Processing, Cambridge, 2015

courses.title: Analog Circuits
syllabus_modules: Amplifier types, bandwidth, two-port network models
Large signal and small signal MOSFET models, common source amplifier, current-mirror biasing, source follower
High frequency MOSFET model, frequency response, Miller effect, cascode amplifier
CMOS differential amplifiers, CMRR, instrumentation amplifier, slew rate, offset voltage
Two-stage op-amp, negative feedback, stability, phase margin, frequency compensation
Oscillators: RC phase shift, Wien bridge, PLL as negative feedback system
references: S. Sedra & K. C. Smith, Microelectronic Circuits, 7th Edn., Oxford, 2015
D. A. Neamen, Electronic Circuit Analysis and Design, 3rd Edn., McGraw-Hill, 2006
Razavi, Fundamentals of Microelectronics, Wiley India, 2009

courses.title: Computer Architecture and Processors
prerequisites: A first level course in Digital Circuits
syllabus_modules: Computer architecture basics, system bus, RISC vs CISC, history of microprocessors
8086 architecture: execution unit, registers, memory segmentation, addressing modes, ISA
8086 instruction set: data transfer, stack, arithmetic, logical, string instructions, interrupts
8086 hardware: pin diagram, memory/IO decoding, interrupt vector table, DMA
8051 microcontroller: architecture, memory, assembly programming using Keil, port programming
8051 internal peripherals: timers, serial communication, interrupts
references: Lyla B. Das, The x86 Microprocessors: 8086 to Pentium, 2nd Edn., Pearson, 2014
M. A. Mazidi et al., The 8051 Microcontroller and Embedded Systems, 2nd Edn., Pearson, 2008
J. L. Hennessy & D. A. Patterson, Computer Architecture, A Quantitative Approach, 5th Edn., Elsevier, 2012

courses.title: Engineering Electromagnetics
syllabus_modules: Transmission lines: voltage/current equations, standing waves, Smith chart, impedance matching, microstrip
Plane waves: Maxwell's equations, polarization, skin depth, reflection/transmission at interfaces, Brewster's angle
Guided waves: rectangular/circular waveguides, TE/TM modes, cut-off wavelength, dominant mode
S-parameters for two-port networks
EM simulation tools: waveguides, matching networks, tees, couplers
references: R. K. Shevgaonkar, Electromagnetic Waves, McGraw Hill, 2016
W. H. Hayt et al., Engineering Electromagnetics, McGraw Hill, 8th Edn., 2020
D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, Wiley, 4th Edn., 2012

courses.title: Analog Circuits Lab
syllabus_modules: Op-amp voltage follower, non-inverting amplifier, gain, frequency response, integrator, differentiator
Log/antilog amplifier and applications
Op-amp as super diode
Extracting small signal model parameters of a transistor
Common drain amplifier as buffer
Common source and cascode amplifiers
Instrumentation amplifier and CMRR
Characterisation of op-amp
Oscillator/multivibrator circuits

courses.title: Foundations of Machine Learning
syllabus_modules: Linear algebra, probability, decision theory, Bayes decision rule, optimization algorithms
Gradient descent, stochastic/mini-batch gradient descent, momentum
Supervised learning design cycle: data exploration, model development, evaluation
Linear regression, logistic regression, classification, cross-validation, regularization
Decision trees, Naive Bayes, Perceptron, MLP, K-NN, MLE
Unsupervised learning: PCA, LDA, K-Means clustering
references: M. P. Deisenroth et al., Mathematics for Machine Learning, Cambridge, 2020
G. James et al., An Introduction to Statistical Learning, Springer, 2013
Lyla B. Das et al., Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, I.K. International, 2023

courses.title: Communication Engineering I
syllabus_modules: Analog communication: AM, DSB/SC, SSB, VSB, FM, PM, methods of generation and demodulation
Noise in receivers, SNR, figure of merit for different modulation schemes
Digital baseband: PAM, TDM, quantization, PCM, DPCM, line coding, ISI, Nyquist criteria, pulse shaping
Signal space representation, matched filter, correlation receiver
Digital bandpass: ASK, PSK, FSK, QPSK, MSK, QAM, M-ary modulation, signal constellation
references: U. Madhow, Introduction to Communication Systems, Cambridge, 2014
R. E. Zeimer & W. H. Tranter, Principles of Communications, Wiley, 7th Edn., 2014
B. P. Lathi & Z. Ding, Modern Digital and Analog Communication Systems, Oxford, 5th Edn., 2019

courses.title: VLSI Design
syllabus_modules: VLSI design flow, MOS transistors, MOSFET capacitances, scaling, short channel effects
CMOS inverter: DC/transient analysis, area, power, noise margin, layout
Multiple input static CMOS logic, logical effort, sizing for minimum delay
Logic styles: Pseudo-NMOS, DCVSL, pass transistor, transmission gate
Dynamic CMOS: charge sharing, domino logic, np-CMOS, sequential circuits
Timing: synchronous timing, clock skew, jitter, clock distribution
Standard cells, arithmetic blocks: adders, multipliers, barrel shifters
6T SRAM and DRAM cell design
references: J. M. Rabaey et al., Digital Integrated Circuits, 2nd Edn., Pearson, 2016
N. H. E. Weste & D. M. Harris, CMOS VLSI Design, 4th Edn., Pearson, 2010
R. J. Baker, CMOS Circuit Design, Layout, and Simulation, 3rd Edn., Wiley-IEEE, 2019

courses.title: Microcontroller Lab
syllabus_modules: Embedded C programming using Keil Microvision IDE, interfacing peripherals to 8051
MSP430: pin-out, memory map, clock generator, interrupts, interfacing peripherals
GPIO, timers, interrupts, analog signal interfacing, relay/display/motor driver interfacing
Designing complete embedded systems for specific applications

courses.title: Control Systems
syllabus_modules: Open-loop and closed-loop systems, transfer function, transient and steady state response
Mathematical modelling of electronic and electro-mechanical systems
Block diagram reduction, signal flow graph, Mason's rule, steady-state error
State space representation, eigenvalues, time domain solution
Stability: Routh-Hurwitz, root locus, Bode plots, gain margin, phase margin
Controller design: P, PI, PD, PID controllers, lag/lead compensators
State space design: pole placement, controllability, observability, case studies using MATLAB
references: N. S. Nise, Control Systems Engineering, 8th Edn., Wiley, 2019
K. Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th Edn., Prentice Hall, 2010
F. Golnaraghi & B. C. Kuo, Automatic Control Systems, 9th Edn., Wiley, 2014

courses.title: Digital Signal Processing
syllabus_modules: DFT, DTFT, DFT properties, approximation of Fourier transform
FFT: Radix-2 DIT and DIF, prime factor algorithms, inverse DFT using FFT
Overlap-save and overlap-add methods
FIR filters: impulse response, linear phase, window design, frequency sampling, minimax design
IIR filters: structures, direct/cascade/parallel/lattice forms
IIR design from analog filters: Butterworth, Chebyshev, bilinear transform, impulse invariant
Finite word length effects, limit cycles
Multirate signal processing: decimation, interpolation
references: J. G. Proakis & D. G. Manolakis, Digital Signal Processing, 4th Edn., Pearson, 2007
Oppenheim & Schafer, Digital Signal Processing, Pearson, 2015
S. K. Mitra, Digital Signal Processing: A Computer Based Approach, McGraw-Hill, 2013

courses.title: Communication Engineering II
syllabus_modules: Source coding: entropy, joint entropy, Huffman codes, Shannon's source coding theorem
Signal detection: AWGN channel, MAP/ML detection, optimal correlation receiver, probability of error
Performance analysis: coherent/noncoherent binary and M-ary modulation schemes
Channel capacity: Shannon-Hartley theorem, bandwidth-energy trade-off
Channel coding: linear block codes, Hamming code, cyclic codes, convolutional codes, Viterbi decoding
Belief propagation decoding, capacity-achieving codes
references: T. M. Cover & J. A. Thomas, Elements of Information Theory, Wiley, 2nd Edn., 2013
J. G. Proakis & M. Salehi, Communication System Engineering, Pearson, 2nd Edn., 2001
S. Lin & D. J. Costello Jr., Error Control Coding, 2nd Edn., Pearson, 2010

courses.title: Communication Engineering Lab
syllabus_modules: AM generation and envelope detection with AGC
Radio frequency amplifier/mixer
FM modulation/demodulation using VCO/PLL
PAM generation and demodulation
Pulse code modulation
Time division multiplexing
BFSK/BPSK modulation and demodulation
QPSK modulation and demodulation
ISI and pulse shaping
Microstrip patch antenna design for wireless communication
BER evaluation for BPSK, QPSK, BFSK
Linear block codes and cyclic codes: encoder and decoder
Convolutional encoder and Viterbi decoder over AWGN

courses.title: Wireless Communication
syllabus_modules: Cellular concept: TDMA, FDMA, CDMA, frequency reuse, co-channel interference, cell splitting
Mobile radio propagation: free space, path loss, multipath, delay spread, Doppler spread, coherence bandwidth
Diversity techniques: selective combining, maximal ratio combining, beamforming, Alamouti scheme
OFDM: cyclic prefix, PAPR, OFDMA, single carrier FDMA, LTE/5G case study
references: T. S. Rappaport, Wireless Communications, Principles and Practice, 2nd Edn., Pearson, 2010
D. Tse & P. Viswanath, Fundamentals of Wireless Communication, Cambridge, 2005
A. Goldsmith, Wireless Communications, Cambridge, 2005

courses.title: Computer Networks
prerequisites: A first level course in Programming
syllabus_modules: OSI and Internet architecture, layering, multiplexing, circuit/packet switching
Data link: framing, error detection, Ethernet (802.3), wireless LAN (802.11), LAN switches
Network layer: IPv4, addressing, ARP, subnetting, CIDR
Transport layer: UDP, TCP (segment format, connection management, congestion control)
QoS: queuing disciplines, weighted fair queuing
references: L. L. Peterson & B. S. Davie, Computer Networks: A System Approach, Elsevier, 6th Edn., 2021
J. F. Kurose & K. W. Ross, Computer Networks: A Top-Down Approach, Pearson, 8th Edn., 2020

courses.title: Project
courses.description: Major project culminating B.Tech. study. Can be analytical, simulation, hardware design, or a combination in ECE areas. Two-phase evaluation by department committee: mid-semester and end-semester.

courses.title: Technical Seminar
courses.description: Students collect materials from books/journals on a chosen topic outside the regular syllabus, organise and present both orally and as a technical report.

courses.title: Summer Internship
courses.description: Students integrate theoretical concepts with industrial practice, developing work culture, communication, interpersonal skills, technical documentation and presentation capabilities.
